title: U-PAIR-1 exact wide-interface merge — pair-selector core, Pass A + symbolic-rank Pass B

universal_pair_selector_core.name: PAIR_SELECTOR_HITTING_3
universal_pair_selector_core.input: disjoint selector pairs {t_i,f_i} plus positive hyperedges of size <=3
universal_pair_selector_core.decision: choose exactly one selector from every pair so every hyperedge is hit

compiler.semantic_theorem: F in 3SAT iff Q(F) in PAIR_SELECTOR_HITTING_3
compiler.witness_map: x_i=1 iff t_i=1; x_i=0 iff f_i=1

universal_pair_selector_core.meaning: a polynomial exact backend for PAIR_SELECTOR_HITTING_3 would yield SAT in P and hence P=NP

falsified_routes.killer: two selector pairs with four edges {tx,ty},{tx,fy},{fx,ty},{fx,fy}
falsified_routes.reason: instance is UNSAT but has no initial unit/forced/empty edge and reaches a non-contradictory local fixed point

falsified_routes.claim_ceiling: proof-system-specific obstruction; not a lower bound against all algorithms

exact_encoding: product_{z in E}(1-z)=0 for every positive edge E

falsified_routes.reason: conditioning k x-bits induces 2^k distinct singleton continuation relations on y

matrix_theorem.definition: M_k[a,b]=1 iff Z_k is satisfied by x=a,y=b
matrix_theorem.consequence: no universal polynomial bound on a single global exact matrix-rank factorization

tensor_theorem.lower_bound_proof: flatten X|Y gives I_(2^k); a CP decomposition with R terms induces a matrix decomposition of rank at most R
tensor_theorem.upper_bound_proof: sum of the 2^k diagonal basis tensors

structure_adaptive_escape.meaning: full global rank is not by itself a universal killer for decomposition-aware tensor networks

finite_checker.role: regression only; theorem follows from identity-matrix argument, not finite runs

next_gate.question: Does there exist one polynomial-time discoverable contraction/decomposition scheme for every OR_3+PAIR instance whose exact intermediate bond/state ranks and total contraction/reconstruction/verification cost are polynomial?
required_success: polynomial bound on every intermediate factor/bond representation
falsifier_strategy: freeze the factor/operator model before testing
measure cut ranks under candidate contraction trees
if every admissible tree requires superpolynomial bond rank, freeze as killer
if a canonical polynomial-bond scheme survives, promote only to candidate and attack adversarially
next_gate.important_model_warning: Every CNF already has a polynomial-size local factor graph. The missing theorem is not compact input factorization; it is polynomial exact elimination/contraction without exponential intermediate complexity.
